deduplication.selection_rule: Select the lexicographically maximal completeness vector (output tokens, all tokens, iteration count, iterations present); equal-best differing usage fingerprints fail closed.

money.cash_spend_classification: unknown; local Claude CLI logs expose token usage, while this project used a subscription/subsidized surface rather than an observed incremental cash charge
money.counterfactual_pricing_status: not computed; no separately frozen, time-versioned request-level rate table was supplied

requests.expansion_rule: Each nonempty usage.iterations entry is one request; otherwise the selected top-level usage object is one request.
